bio: >
  Erin’s is a Master's student whose research focuses on the salt marsh restoration strategy of thin layer placement in the Wells National Estuarine Research Reserve in Maine. She is interested in understanding how microbial communities and the biogeochemical cycles they mediate respond over time after restoration, with the long-term goal of understanding how incorporating microbial monitoring may provide a deeper understanding of restoration success. She is also assisting a project focused on characterizing oyster microbiomes in Great Bay, NH. During her graduate studies and in her future career, she hopes to connect with local communities and stakeholders for collaboration and to share her research.
